title: Prediction of early lung adenocarcinoma spread through air spaces by machine learning radiomics: a cross-center cohort study.
summary: Radiomics and machine-learning models using CT features predicted spread through air spaces in lung adenocarcinoma across cohorts, with cross-center evaluation; this is a preoperative pathology-prediction result limited by retrospective design.
ai_technology: Radiomic feature extraction and machine-learning classifiers used CT features to predict pathology-confirmed spread through air spaces.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: Radiomics and machine-learning models using CT features predicted spread through air spaces in lung adenocarcinoma across cohorts, with cross-center evaluation; this is a preoperative pathology-prediction result limited by retrospective design.
evidence.unknown: The cross-center evaluation is retrospective; predictive association with pathology does not show prospective clinical utility or improved outcomes.
